overall_goal: Clean the kitchen by loading the dishwasher, managing food waste, and washing remaining dishes by hand

goals.description: Scrub and load items into the dishwasher bottom rack
goals.rationale: The person opens the dishwasher, prepares the brush, and scrubs various utensils and plates before placing them in the bottom rack.

goals.description: Load items into the dishwasher top rack
goals.rationale: The person pulls out the top rack and places a cheese grater, a scrubbed plastic container, a small bowl, and a coffee cup into it.

goals.description: Sort remaining items, finish loading the dishwasher, and close it
goals.rationale: The person sorts out items to be washed by hand, places the last few items like a teaspoon and coffee jug into the dishwasher, pushes the racks in, and closes the door.
The person grabs a cloth, dries their hands, and puts the cloth back.

goals.description: Retrieve and open a new paper food waste bag
goals.rationale: The person opens the cupboard, takes out a paper food waste bag, and unfolds it to prepare for waste transfer.

goals.description: Transfer food waste into the paper bag and dispose of the non-compostable plastic bag
goals.rationale: The person drops an eggshell into the paper bag, retrieves a plastic bag of food waste, empties its contents into the paper bag, and throws the empty plastic bag into the general waste bin.

goals.description: Insert the filled paper bag into the food waste bin and store it
goals.rationale: The person retrieves the food waste bin, places the paper bag inside it, closes the lid, and returns the bin to the cupboard.

goals.description: Rinse hands and prepare the sponge with washing up liquid
goals.rationale: The person puts away the dishwasher brush, rinses their hands and a sponge, and applies washing up liquid to the sponge.

goals.description: Wash the wooden spoon, spatula, and frying pan by hand
goals.rationale: The person uses the soapy sponge to hand-wash items that cannot go in the dishwasher or are needed soon, then rinses the frying pan and places it on the drying rack.

goals.description: Rinse the spatula thoroughly and place it in the cutlery stand
goals.rationale: The person rinses the spatula, notices remaining food, scrubs it again with the sponge, rinses it completely, and stores it in the cutlery stand.
